TestSubmission.title: Test Submission
TestSubmission.description: Represents a single attempt by a user for a specific test.

testId.description: The ID of the test that was taken.

userId.description: The ID of the user who took the test.

answers.description: A map of question numbers to the user's selected answers.

submittedAt.description: The timestamp when the test was submitted.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Collection to store all user test submissions.
